title: Sybil: lung-cancer risk prediction up to six years from a low-dose CT
summary: The model predicts risk from a single CT with a six-year C-index of 0.75 (NLST), 0.81 (MGH) and 0.80 (CGMH), and a one-year ROC area between 0.86 and 0.94. Retrospective validation on three independent datasets; trained only on smokers, with prospective testing and testing in nonsmokers as next steps.
organization: MIT; Mass General Cancer Center and Chang Gung Memorial Hospital

evidence.tested: The model was trained on NLST low-dose CT scans and validated on a held-out NLST set and two independent cohorts (MGH and CGMH), with six-year C-index 0.75, 0.81 and 0.80; the abstract describes no prospective testing.
evidence.unknown: The abstract states that future study is required to understand clinical applications; the press release says prospective testing and testing in nonsmokers are next steps.
evidence.ai_role: A deep learning model predicts lung-cancer risk from a single low-dose chest CT.
